phys-bio-01-c1.text: Debashish Chowdhury (2005). 100 years of Einstein's theory of Brownian motion: from pollen grains to protein trains. arXiv preprint cond-mat/0504610 (Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur).
phys-bio-01-c1.quote: We must assume that the suspended particles perform an irregular movement- even if a very slow one- in the liquid, on account of the molecular movement of the liquid
phys-bio-01-c1.claim: Robert Brown noticed this in 1827, and in 1905 Einstein explained it: water molecules in random thermal motion keep kicking the grains.
